task_description: Final launch push (~48h to launch, Excel data migration to follow) across three parts, sequenced launch-critical-first. Wave C (FEAT-001): make the DB rebuild runnable + documented (schema/*.sql has zero INSERTs; seeds live in migrations 28/29/30/32; DEPLOY_GUIDE.md is missing the §W8g rebuild section) — the user's Excel migration sits on top of this. Wave A (FEAT-002/003/004, the user's 'critical' part): move collection-DOCX generation server-side COMPLETELY. FEAT-002 ports the docxFill renderer to Render with a golden-baseline parity proof, fixes the module-level render-report singleton (concurrency bug at jobsMaxConcurrent=3), and closes the xmldom lockfile trap on the lockfile-less server-render. FEAT-003 moves the auto-generate-on-save (collection_jobs) fill server-side preserving the exact generate->WhatsApp->email order with no double-send and every P0-03/P0-04 invariant, dropping filled_base64 from D1. FEAT-004 moves the bulk path fill to Render too ('bulk wala to pura wahi pe kar do'). Wave B (FEAT-005): the last frontend item — upgrade mgmt/frontend to react-router-dom@7.18.4 (test harness first on v6, then upgrade, add React app to CI, delete the PR-47 guard test that is designed to fail at >=7.18.0). Cross-service constraints (no D1/R2 on Render, Worker writes R2, byte-contract drift test, per-result report, QR placement, renderer parity) are baked into the Wave A designs. NOTE FOR ORCHESTRATOR: a separate deployment blocker — the public portal's live Vercel build is stale (live /expenses canonical + 8-URL sitemap vs merged 11-URL) — must be checked in the Vercel dashboard (Production Branch=main, Node 20/22, latest deploy commit + build logs); if merges do not deploy, none of this work reaches production for launch. The planner/coder cannot push; the orchestrator publishes each PR.
